tools.name: reoon_account_balance
tools.description: Read remaining daily and instant Reoon credits without verifying an email.

tools.name: reoon_verify_email
tools.description: Check email syntax, domain/MX and disposable-address signals in QUICK mode. Does NOT verify inbox existence or guarantee delivery. Can spend Reoon credits; confirm:true is required. Do not run continuously in more than five parallel requests. Use bulk verification for lists.

tools.name: reoon_create_bulk_verification
tools.description: Submit 10–1,000 emails for asynchronous POWER verification. Starts a vendor job and can spend verification credits. Requires confirm:true; the job may continue if the response is lost. Check the dashboard before resubmitting. Results are later read with reoon_bulk_results.

tools.name: reoon_bulk_results
tools.description: Read a previously created bulk task, its progress, and a bounded page of completed email results. Does not start new verification. Wait between polls. Very large upstream exports must be downloaded in the Reoon dashboard.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: reoon_account_balance, reoon_verify_email, reoon_create_bulk_verification, reoon_bulk_results · Public sink: reoon_account_balance, reoon_verify_email, reoon_create_bulk_verification, reoon_bulk_results · Destructive: reoon_verify_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: reoon_account_balance, reoon_verify_email, reoon_create_bulk_verification, reoon_bulk_results · Public sink: reoon_account_balance, reoon_verify_email, reoon_create_bulk_verification, reoon_bulk_results · Destructive: reoon_verify_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
